semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides specialized equipment and tools for advanced R&D in semiconductor applications.
summary: Allied Resourcing is an engineering consultancy and trade facilitator that represents international manufacturers of instruments and equipment essential for advanced semiconductor research and development. They supply high-end photomasks and laser direct imagers, among other specialized tools, catering to various semiconductor-related applications.
capabilities: Photomasks made of Quartz, Sodalime, and Polymer
High-end Laser Direct Imager (LDI) for semiconductor applications
Optical Tweezer Systems for precision manipulation
technical_expertise: Computer vision and machine learning for material detection

regional_presence.India: The company is participating in SEMICON 2026 in New Delhi, indicating a focus on the Indian market.
